request.summary: 本轮真实 canonical publication、product_db 首屏/older ACK 和 Android 缓存提交成立；但 Node importer 将内部 Diagnostic 载体作为产品 HistoryItem 发布，且具体结构化事件字段的 App 可见证据仍不足。Rust 原阻塞已解除；S2 保持未完成，不修改代码、不推进步骤。

findings.title: 在 Node 产品投影构造时排除内部 Diagnostic 载体
findings.body: productRowsFromSnapshot 将 snapshot.items 全部按 item_key 分组，并与 reduced item keys 做并集；没有 reduced 历史项的 Diagnostic 也被生成为 HistoryItem。实际 canonical 产品库 228 条中 130 条为 Diagnostic（developer_message_hidden=3、token_usage_record=21、reasoning_item=42 等），readConversation/provider 原样传出；Android product_db 缓存已有 45 条，其中首屏 42 条占 20 条。只读调用当前真实 provider 可重现相同 tail rangeId 与 20 条 Diagnostic。这违反产品契约 3.2 的 raw analyzer diagnostics 隔离要求并占用分页预算。问题位于既有 Node 投影构造，非本轮新增 Node 代码，也非 Rust canonical 重新失败。应按事件来源/schema 排除诊断载体，保留内部 staging/checkpoint 诊断及业务 payload 中合法同名 diagnostic 字段，不在 Gateway 按字段名猜测删除。没有发现开发者正文泄漏。
findings.scope_note: Importer projection correction is outside current Task005 narrow Node provider/sync compatibility scope. A separately scoped Node task or confirmed plan revision is needed before implementation; review alone does not authorize it.

findings.title: 补齐具体结构化事件字段在 App 可见的 S2 证据
findings.body: 产品库读取、delta、ACK 与缓存提交只能证明送达和持久化；当前引用的 product-db-unlocked.png 仍有 WebSocket failure 对话框，展示终态 assistant 文本与会话 PATH header，未显示可与具体产品历史 item 对应的结构化事件 path/cwd/command/code 值。其他截图两张全黑、一张零字节，无法补足此项。S2 明确要求一个具体结构化事件字段值在 App 可见，因此这项仍未验证。无需增加产品来源 UI 徽标或改变 healthy IPC authority，应在现有数据流内记录具体 item/字段/值与可见观察的对应关系。
requirements: Adopted Task005 acceptance: concrete event fact visible

prior_findings_assessment.assessment: 新执行已补足原先没有 canonical product row、没有产品 ACK 的子缺口。当前仍缺具体结构化字段 UI 可见验收，并新增内部诊断进入产品边界发现。旧 needs-revision 不被改写，旧测试报告不被重新标 fresh。

coverage.target: Latest Task005 S2 execution cbc083; read-only current source, existing runtime artifacts, SQLite and screenshots; not a new device/host run
requirements: IPC authority remains live-only; bounded product history is static baseline/older

product_db.note: Execution first run has one receipt; live DB now contains three separately committed publications. Later publications are not treated as duplicate bugs or evidence of S4 acceptance.

android_cache.note: 42 tail + 53 older = 95 unique items; 54 older wire upserts include one overlap. Partial coverage with has_more_before is correct for a bounded range.

provider_replay.method: Read-only SQLite extraction and in-memory invocation of current CodexHistoryProductProvider.readInitial with rangeEnabled=true; no service/ADB/Rust call or DB write

transport.correlation: Exact syncIds link product_read.started -> delta -> positive ACK to Android completed page hashes; server hashes are logged as short prefixes. Earlier snapshot/IPC 34-item sync is not counted as product evidence.

Connected Codex header; final assistant prose visible; WebSocket failure dialog present; no concrete structured path/cwd/command/code event field demonstrated

reported_by_execution.observation: Debug analyzer built successfully; current executable was used by the local service.
No diff errors; only existing LF/CRLF conversion warnings.
Local service healthy on 3010 with IPC enabled.

reported_by_execution.command: Real target conversation 01a0ee04-a775-72b3-bd07-04aac804a3b4 through the single existing Rust collection chain
reported_by_execution.observation: Rust run completed canonical, 228 logical items, one durable publication receipt; product DB conversation and history rows committed.

reported_by_execution.command: adb -s MQS7N19402011743 restart and reselect target; range-enabled history sync
reported_by_execution.observation: Server recorded product_read.started, first page upsertCount=42, older upsertCount=54, and ok=true ACKs; Android cache target row is provider_mode=product_db with tail 42 and older 53 committed items. A transient WebSocket failure dialog appeared during restart and was dismissed; healthy IPC remained authoritative.

reused_validation.note: 3/3 realRust and 122/122 collector results retained as execution/test-record observations; not independently rerun in this review or used to claim App UI acceptance.

new_validation: Read-only actual artifact SHA-256 equals execution
34 prior Rust subject hashes equal current files
Read-only SQLite aggregates, publication/staging/coverage, cache page and segment queries
not_run: No new Rust build/test, Node full suite, Android Gradle/instrumentation, ADB/device interaction, service restart, WebSocket/E2E, external host request, deployment or Git mutation
No S3/S4 acceptance; incident older/restart observations do not finish them

provenance.observation_sources: Existing execution journal, current source, real runtime artifacts and read-only local queries; execution claims distinguished from new observations

limits: UI visibility and transient WebSocket failure remain unverified; screenshot cannot establish a clean post-dismissal scene.

Binary digest matches recorded output; runtime record/log do not independently pin the loaded process binary bytes or compiler inputs. Separate Rust source hash comparison does not by itself prove that integration load.
Live SQLite/log/artifact paths are mutable; hashes and selected aggregate/log facts are frozen in this review request, without capturing raw private conversation payloads.
Current tests are focused and reused; no full release, deployment or broad S3/S4 acceptance.
Existing issue-ec19a134aefeb23287cb519b remains unresolved; no guessed association repair.
Task004 C2-store-final, C2-publish, C4-flow-final, C4-unattended remain historical/stale; this Task005 evidence does not make them fresh.
remaining_work: Keep Task005 S2 in-progress with these findings; no finish, advance, close or Git action.
Prepare a Node-scoped importer projection repair or revise/confirm Task005 scope before changing importer; current plan only includes Node provider/sync compatibility.
After boundary correction, supplement actual S2 concrete event field visibility and review new execution without changing healthy IPC authority.
S3 detail/history compatibility and S4 expanded real scenarios remain not-started.
Unassociated management issue may be linked/corrected/resolved/deferred separately; no business work replay.

recommendation.reason: Node importer projection correction is outside the adopted narrow Node provider/sync scope; first scope the repair. Runtime may advise execute-step/repair for the unfinished S2; that advice is not authorization to widen implementation.
